name: MPN CML PV ET Myelofibrosis Long Case

reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: BCR-ABL drives granulocytic overgrowth with massive spleens; JAK2 mutates PV with low EPO and plethora, ET with platelet clots, and fibrosis scars marrow into tear-drop leukoerythroblastosis.
additionalDifferentials: CML versus PV versus ET versus fibrosis by BCR JAK EPO and smear
Chronic versus blast by counts and phase
Clonal versus reactive by LAP and BCR
additionalInvestigations: BCR-ABL PCR with JAK2 EPO LAP
